qa_pairs.question: Why might the resource statistics for an entire node be inaccurate?
qa_pairs.answer: Resource statistics for an entire node may be inaccurate if the node is shared by multiple users.

qa_pairs.question: What information does the graph on the right display concerning node-level resource usage?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph on the right shows the evolution of the network bandwidth used by a job or a set of jobs via the Infiniband network, over time.

qa_pairs.question: What types of activities can be observed as periods of massive data transfer from the network bandwidth graph?
qa_pairs.answer: Periods of massive data transfer can be observed, such as reading/writing on a filesystem (e.g., Lustre) or MPI communication between nodes.
